entry.title: Canadian Maple + Carbon Insert Shaft
entry.summary:
Vendor: Cues Master Shop
Type:
Price: 3500.00

Traditional feel. Modern performance.

The Canadian Maple Shaft with Carbon Insert is a hybrid cue shaft designed for players who want the natural feel and feedback of premium maple with the added stability and low-deflection characteristics of carbon technology.

Crafted from carefully selected Canadian maple, the shaft delivers the warm, familiar feedback and playing feel associated with a traditional wooden shaft. Integrated into the front section is a carbon fiber insert, reinforcing the shaft where stability matters most while maintaining a lightweight and responsive construction.

Why the Carbon Insert?

When applying English or side spin, the cue ball can move away from the intended aiming line—a phenomenon commonly known as cue-ball squirt or deflection. Shaft construction, particularly the mass and stiffness of the front section, plays an important role in how the shaft responds to off-center hits.

The carbon insert reinforces and stabilizes the front section of the maple shaft, helping reduce front-end movement while maintaining the natural characteristics of the wood. The result is a more predictable shaft response when applying side spin, draw, follow, and other cue-ball control techniques.

Key Advantages

  • Low-Deflection Performance — Helps reduce cue-ball squirt when applying English
  • Natural Maple Feel — Maintains the familiar feedback and response of real Canadian maple
  • Carbon Reinforcement — Adds stiffness and stability to the front section
  • Improved Spin Control — Provides a more predictable response when using side spin, draw, and follow
  • Consistent Power Transfer — Reinforced construction helps transfer energy efficiently through the shaft
  • Stable Response — Carbon reinforcement helps reduce some of the variability associated with an all-wood front section
  • Traditional + Modern — Combines the feel of genuine maple with the performance advantages of carbon technology

The Best of Both Worlds

Canadian Maple delivers the natural feel, feedback, and character of real wood.

Carbon Insert adds stability, stiffness, and low-deflection performance.

Together, they create a hybrid shaft designed for players who want to feel the cue while maintaining greater control over the cue ball.

Natural wood feel. Carbon-enhanced stability. Low-deflection performance.

Cues Master — Modern Technology. Human Craftsmanship. 🎱
